score_semantics: relative evidence and utility; not calibrated probability

feature_definitions.expert_rank_percentile: Average-tie rank percentile in [0,1] computed from information strictly before the target.
feature_definitions.expert_rank_skill: Mean over target winners of 2*q-1; updated only after target scoring.
feature_definitions.candidate_disagreement: Reliability-weighted standard deviation of expert rank percentiles.
feature_definitions.threshold_utility: Weighted normalized elementary symmetric products at same-line thresholds 3,4,5.

candidate_pool_policy.change_gate: new model version plus prospective review

coalition_scoring_formula.specialist_mixture: reliability-weighted log-sum-exp of expert line utilities

portfolio_objective.diversification: soft penalty only when two lines share more than two coordinates

null_tests.candidate_uniform: exact rank and hypergeometric Top-K null
null_tests.assembly_uniform_pool: unique random lines from identical frozen pool and line count
null_tests.assembly_exposure_matched: approximate MCMC degree-preserving swaps holding each coordinate exposure fixed
null_tests.assembly_exposure_matched_caveat: finite-chain mixing is not proven; positive claims require convergence checks or an exact sampler

powerball.coupling_gate: preregistered out-of-sample lift over independent PB ranker
